description: Count words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, lines and unique words; estimate reading (238 wpm) and speaking (150 wpm) time; list the most used keywords with density. Works for English and Arabic (tashkeel ignored). Give "text" or a text file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/word-count/

includeStopWords.description: Count common words like "the"/"في" as keywords.

keywords.description: How many top keywords to return (0 = none).

path.description: Or: a path to a UTF-8 text file.

name: text_word_count
title: Word count
